title: The history of the world's largest fastener distributor - Design World
content: # The history of the world’s largest fastener distributor. As World War II slowly came to an end, Adolf Würth knew two things: he needed to support his family and he wanted to work independently. His daughter, Bettina Würth, is the current Chairwoman of the Advisory Board of the Würth Group. So, in the summer of 1945, Würth officially set up his own business — Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG, which became the parent company of today’s Würth Group — selling screws in Künzelsau, Baden-Württemberg (Germany). Although today’s Würth Group is an example of a massive and successful global enterprise, it did not start this way. That was in 1954, when Dr. Würth took over with the support of his mother, Alma Würth, making the Würth Group a two-person company. One part of this global growth includes Würth Industry North America (WINA), which is now a $1 billion division of the Würth Group.
